runtime: test-classpath offline shadow only; no Spring component/config/API
base: production SqlMemoryProvider result prefix unchanged; candidate may only append until total12
normalization: reuse production recallTerms and lexical score; NFKC/lowercase only to locate existing query terms in query/body
supplement_rule: Original 75 percent lexical coverage fails; do not change its threshold.
All scored non-Han terms match using the original exact English/alphanumeric token scoring.
Exactly one distinct scored Han bigram is absent from the body; at least two distinct scored Han bigrams match.
Every query Han position participating in scored bigrams is covered by a matched bigram; at least four positions participate.
Within each Han run, maximal contiguous matched-bigram spans must occur contiguously and in order, without overlap, in the normalized body.
No synonym table, question ID, expected key, entity dictionary, translation or answer is used. No distance window is tuned.
supplement_order: unchanged lexical score descending, created_at descending, id ascending; preserve base prefix; total <=12

metrics: negative-return query counts by existing category
evaluation.strict_support: Related contradictory sources are not proof of the requested entity/date/attribute; report these errors separately, never as model-answer hallucinations.
evaluation.promotion: NONE; no production/default/quality threshold adoption regardless of development result
evaluation.existing_safety: Current actor/scope/status/source/fingerprint revalidation, deletion and revocation must remain effective.

holdout.author: must be assigned independently after code and evaluation hashes freeze; current executor has seen dev answers and cannot claim blindness
holdout.corpus: new source/fact families; no dev facts or query templates; immutable gold/hash; candidate fixed before unsealing
